svg.aria-label: Step responses of the plant 1 over s squared plus 10 s plus 20 under four controllers. Open loop: output only 0.05. P with Kp 300: fast but settles at 0.94 with overshoot. PD with Kp 300 and Kd 10: overshoot damped, error remains. PID with Kp 350, Ki 300, Kd 50: no offset and almost no overshoot.
